page_title: STR 0-0 REI | Strasbourg v Reims 08/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+1' A clumsy foul by Buta (Reims) and Thomas Leonard blows his whistle.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' A free kick on the edge of the box for Reims. Let's see if they'll manage to convert it into a goal.
89' Luka Elsner appears to have said too much and referee Thomas Leonard comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
89' Although Luka Elsner (Reims) is just on the bench, Thomas Leonard has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
87' Jeremy Sebas (Strasbourg) controls a cross deep inside the box and hits the crossbar!
86' A substitution has been made. Keito Nakamura is replaced by Mamadou Diakhon (Reims).
84' 48:52 – the latest ball possession ratio.
83' Junya Ito (Reims) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
82' Junya Ito (Reims) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
81' The game is interrupted as Junya Ito (Reims) is flagged offside.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Oumar Diakite trots off the pitch and is replaced by Amine Salama (Reims).
76' Cedric Kipre (Reims) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
75' Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

75' A sweet pass finds Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the right side of the goal. Yehvann Diouf is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
74' Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) will take a corner kick.
73' The substitution is prepared. Jeremy Sebas (Strasbourg) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Emanuel Emegha.
73' Liam Rosenior has decided to substitute Sekou Mara and he is replaced by Abdoul Ouattara (Strasbourg).

71' Junya Ito sends a lovely lofted pass forward that flies over the top of the defence and into the path of Marshall Munetsi (Reims), but he can't direct his header on target as it flies well over the bar.
71' Here comes a substitution. Gabriel Moscardo (Reims) is brought on as a substitute for Valentin Atangana Edoa.
70' The number of shots on goal at present is 1:3.
68' It's a free kick to Strasbourg, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
64' The foul by Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) was seen by Thomas Leonard who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
63' Amadou Kone (Reims) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
63' Junya Ito (Reims) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
62' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.
61' Strasbourg enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
59' Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) sends a long ball in, but Djordje Petrovic comfortably gathers the ball.

57' Marshall Munetsi (Reims) gets into a good shooting position. He wins some space for himself and drills a long-range daisy-cutter towards the middle of the goal. His good effort is, however, superbly saved by Djordje Petrovic!
55' Cedric Kipre (Reims) shows his brilliant passing ability after picking out Junya Ito with a fine lofted pass.

53' Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now. Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.

52' Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment. Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
51' A brilliant individual effort! Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) tricks his way past challenges into the box and drags his shot narrowly wide of the left post.
49' Oumar Diakite (Reims) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+1' Thomas Leonard has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

44' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) makes a decision to dribble through the defence towards the goal. He gets inside the box, pulls the trigger, but hits the ball very poorly and it goes yards wide of the target.

44' Junya Ito (Reims) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He receives a precise lofted cross inside the box and sends a quick shot to the roof of the net, but he can't get the power to direct it past Djordje Petrovic, who keeps it out.
43' Junya Ito (Reims) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
42' Keito Nakamura (Reims) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
40' Strasbourg are awarded a mid-range free kick.
39' Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) gets booked for the first time in this match.
36' That's a clear yellow card. Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg) goes into the book.
35' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Sekou Mara (Strasbourg), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
34' 0:1 – this is the current number of shots on target.
32' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Reims.
30' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
26' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Yehvann Diouf intercepts the ball.
21' Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
17' Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
16' Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
14' Strasbourg seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
10' Lovely cross from Keito Nakamura to find Junya Ito (Reims) deep in the box, but he steers his header well over the bar.
7' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Yehvann Diouf, who smothers the ball.
4' Strasbourg will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.

3' Nice individual effort by Keito Nakamura (Reims). He gets all the way to the goalkeeper, produces a strike towards the right side of the target, but Djordje Petrovic does a good job to anticipate the direction of the ball and keeps it out with a save.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Reims will kick-off.
Thomas Leonard will officiate today.
